{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask]

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_mask = filtered_df['status'] == 'completed'
completed_df = filtered_df[completed_mask]

# Now compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA and refunded)
mean_revenue_completed = completed_df['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"QA orders removed: {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Completed orders after removing QA: {len(completed_df)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue_completed:.2f}")"}
